b1-europaiorokseg-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Authors and Their Works
b1-europaiorokseg-01.scenario: In a literature class, your teacher asks who wrote the Faust and who translated Hamlet into Hungarian.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.prompt: Tell your teacher who wrote the Faust and who translated Shakespeare's Hamlet into Hungarian.
cues: Name the author of the Faust
b1-europaiorokseg-01.target: A Faustot Goethe írta, Shakespeare Hamletjét pedig Arany János fordította magyarra.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.english: Goethe wrote the Faust, and Arany János translated Shakespeare's Hamlet into Hungarian.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.canDo: I can name famous works of European literature and their authors, from Homer to Goethe.

b1-europaiorokseg-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Dickens Novel
b1-europaiorokseg-02.scenario: At a book club, a friend asks what Dickens's novel Oliver Twist shows.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.prompt: Tell your friend what Dickens presents in the novel Oliver Twist.
cues: Name the author and the novel
b1-europaiorokseg-02.target: Dickens a Twist Olivérben az árvaságot mutatja be.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.english: In Oliver Twist, Dickens presents the plight of orphans.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.canDo: I can name famous 19th-century novels and their authors, from Pushkin to Tolstoy.

b1-europaiorokseg-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Himnusz and Its Music
b1-europaiorokseg-03.scenario: At a music school, your teacher asks who set the Himnusz to music and when.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.prompt: Tell your teacher who set Kölcsey's Himnusz to music, and in which year.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.target: Erkel Ferenc 1844-ben megzenésítette Kölcsey Ferenc Himnuszát.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.english: Ferenc Erkel set Ferenc Kölcsey's Himnusz to music in 1844.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.canDo: I can name famous composers and their works, from Bach to Liszt.

b1-europaiorokseg-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Hungarian Ballad
b1-europaiorokseg-04.scenario: In a Hungarian literature class, your teacher asks who wrote A walesi bárdok and what the ballad is about.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.prompt: Tell your teacher who wrote the ballad A walesi bárdok and what it is about.
cues: Say what the ballad is about
b1-europaiorokseg-04.target: A walesi bárdok című balladát Arany János írta. A ballada a zsarnokságról szól.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.english: Arany János wrote the ballad A walesi bárdok. The ballad is about tyranny.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.canDo: I can name the classics of Hungarian literature and their best-known works.

b1-europaiorokseg-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Nobel Prize in Literature
b1-europaiorokseg-05.scenario: At the library, a librarian asks which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature and when.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.prompt: Tell the librarian which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature, and in which year.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.target: Kertész Imre 2002-ben elnyerte az irodalmi Nobel-díjat.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.english: Imre Kertész won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2002.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.canDo: I can name the writers of the Nyugat generation and later Hungarian authors and their works.

b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Culture Quiz
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.scenario: At a school quiz about European and Hungarian culture, the quiz master asks you to name a composer and a writer, each with a work or prize.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.prompt: Say who composed the Ode to Joy and which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
cues: Name the composer and the work
Name the writer and the prize
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.target: Beethoven szerezte az Örömódát. Kertész Imre elnyerte az irodalmi Nobel-díjat.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.english: Beethoven composed the Ode to Joy. Imre Kertész won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about European and Hungarian literature and music and their best-known works.
